_comment: The art project's provenance record (docs/art-bible.md section 17's ruling): one entry per asset family, and rows per asset as they land. Read by tools/provenance-check.mjs in npm run check. A family's entry is what the construction-order ruling calls its README: the lock, the ramps, the master and reference paths by hash, the checkpoints, the originality verdict. Byte shares are integers that sum to at most 12,582,912 (bible 16.2).

tiles.masterReason: a CSS family ships no file; the stylesheet is the master

lock.bandRenders: measured with a middle tile sounding at every density, both sides: toward either neighbour gap minus ring - 3 / 1 / 0 / 1 CSS px (13-14 / 4-5 / 0 / 3 device px on the Galaxy at 4.5 and the short stage at 3), the rest beneath the neighbour's box (the live tile paints beneath its siblings); the neighbour's rim whole every time; the full band on the open sides
lock.highlightNote: drawn 2 px, of which 1 shows inside the 1 px rim; the lower shade likewise

compact.why: a ten-tile tray under eight slots ran under the grown-up strip at 320 px; at S7's floor it fits (the monkey, 2026-08-22)

electricArea.formula: 2*(w+h+band)*band over the viewport, one tile sounding at a time (popOverlap)
electricArea.tile: sh on the iPhone 13 profile, 47 x 42 CSS px, band 6

tiles.checkpointBasis: a CSS family lands no file: checkpoint 2 was judged on tokens tests 8-10, the census's sounding-state cell and sampled device pixels on the renders; the scenery statistic is first built by the garden-scene step

checkpoints.renders: D:/CVCGame-ops/art/step1/checkpoint (the single path then in use; its sets were overwritten by later captures and none survives - the 0d887f3 set at D:/CVCGame-ops/art/step1/0d887f3 is the one that does, and every set since lives in a folder named for its commit)
checkpoints.basis: value on the luminance-greyscale renders with the word on them: the tile is a form by its rim and contact shadow alone, the letters on a flat face, the sounding tile one event

checkpoints.commit: 0d887f3 (re-given at the sixth judgement; first given on 34355ed, then 3c11232)
checkpoints.basis: The verdict rests on the 0d887f3 set at D:/CVCGame-ops/art/step1/0d887f3 (hashes.json: 119 hashed renders - the 85 of the standing capture, the 12 descender renders with the word's layer and the 12 with it planted away, the 6 attempt-phase renders (one per profile) the junction reads take the word's ink from, pressed on two profiles, the landscape phone's two - plus 24 close crops cut from the hashed renders' own bytes, and the junction and junctionLayerRemoved reads), re-given at the sixth judgement on 2026-08-22 by the art director (every hashed render matching its hash, the seven run-notes found verbatim in their PNGs) and held by the reading chair at the seventh (2026-08-23). First given on the 64 renders of 34355ed and re-given at the fifth judgement on the 85 of 3c11232; both sets were overwritten at the one path then in use, so neither survives - since the sixth judgement every set lives in a folder named for its commit and a judged set is never overwritten. The compact 56 px variant is judged in (the ruled ceramic at 56 and 64 px, a multi-letter unit one wider tile at 76 as at 90). Device pixels sampled on the Galaxy S9+ (4.5), the Pixel 7 (2.625), the iPhone 13 (3) and the desktop (1) sounding, density, completed, focus, scaffold, sentence, arrangement and one-placed renders against the lock (ring 3, band 6 / 4 / 2 / 4, rim 1, highlight 1 showing, haloInset 4, bandRenders), plus tokens tests 8-10, provenance-check and doc-truth green; pressed captured on the Galaxy and the iPhone 13: the face renders #edd07d, the arithmetic's #eed07d to one unit of the compositor's rounding, the bevel gone and the rim kept. The live tile's z-index changes which side occludes the band, not the band. The word's own layer (the fifth judgement) changes what a descender meets: the band and ring no longer hide a tail (with the layer planted away they hid 969 of 980 ink pixels of the p's tail on the Galaxy, 653 of 744 on the Pixel 7, 451 of 462 on the iPhone 13), and until open-faults AF's clearance lands a tail paints over the ring where it reaches it - the whole 3 px ring on the Pixel 7, the short stage and the desktop (entering the tile by 0.3-0.7 px on the short stage and 3 px on the desktop), touching it on the landscape phone, none on the Galaxy or the iPhone 13 - a trade judged on this set by the art director and the reading chair: the thing being taught is never covered by its cue. Two exceptions to 'closed on all four sides' are recorded, both older than the step and both the reading surface's: a descender over the ring's top edge (AF) and the landscape phone's stage edge cutting the row's bottom side (AG).

originality.test: bible 18.2 combination test on the family as rendered
originality.verdict: passes - a material, not a character: a rounded-rectangle glazed tile with a one-pixel highlight and rim, a contact shadow and the project's own token rings; no third-party game, interface, character or asset identifiable; nothing suggests an answer
originality.renders: D:/CVCGame-ops/art/step1/checkpoint (the single path then in use; its sets were overwritten by later captures and none survives - the 0d887f3 set at D:/CVCGame-ops/art/step1/0d887f3 is the one that does, and every set since lives in a folder named for its commit)

glowseed.masterReason: a token-drawn placeholder ships no file; the stylesheet is the master until the garden's step draws the pixel seed to the locked camera
glowseed.placeholder: D, owner-ruled 2026-08-23 on the Glowseed page (the questions were A / B / D; C refused by bible 17's standing rule; the council recommended D and the owner ruled D): a token-drawn placeholder approved under the owner's 'who draws' ruling ('state 0 with placeholder geometry'), bible 8.1's row untouched; the pixel seed lands at step 6 as a drop-in paint on the same component, place, looks and cells. The build was made on the recommendation before the ruling returned, so the checkpoint renders would be real; the ruling matched it and nothing changed.
glowseed.lifecycle: lit at the utterance's schedule (voicepacks.js onAudio start: 50 ms before the first sample and the first clip's lead before any voice), idle when every node of the utterance - the clips and the hum's oscillators - has fired onended, counted to zero and keyed by the utterance's token, or when stopClips() ends it; never on the system-speech fallback, with sound off, or on a decode failure; a lost end (a closed context) lasts until the next stopClips(). Probed under headless Chromium 2026-08-23: onended fires at a natural end, on stop(), and 1,500 ms late through a context suspended that long.
glowseed.place: out of flow in the stage's top-right corner, 0 px of layout (the census's Glowseed cell holds every zone's height and the word's box equal with the object planted away); in the free sky measured on the 0d887f3 renders (46-181 CSS px on the Galaxy S9+, 46-279 Pixel 7, 46-199 iPhone 13, 46-232 desktop, 46-167 short stage); absent on a stage under 400 px tall (the landscape phone, open-faults AG); on the word reveal, the sentence reveal, the pre-ladder and Build-it - not home, the done screens or the corner; right rather than left is settled (the art director, the after pass 2026-08-23): measured on galaxy-s9plus-attempt-idle-grey.png the header's own weight is left-heavy (mean |grey-197| of 19.8 left against 9.7 right), so a mark on the right loads the lighter side, and with the object lit the stage's top band reads 0.2 left against 1.1 right

ratios.pair: stone to purpleStructural (the idle-to-lit rim step, the non-colour cue)
cyanElectric on slot (the core alone is no cue)
stone on skyBlue (the idle rim, declared decorative below 3:1)
purpleElectric on skyLavender (the light, never the boundary)

electricArea.formula: pixels within 30 of each electric token over the whole frame, counted on the checkpoint renders
electricArea.note: measured by the art director on the 87f9272 renders (the after pass, 2026-08-23), replacing the arithmetic estimate of 0.51 / 0.62; the budget is 1-3 % (bible 9.1) and this is the band plus the object together while a tile sounds

glowseed.checkpointBasis: checkpoint 1 on greyscale renders of the reveal with a tile sounding, the sentence reveal, Build-it and the pre-ladder's ear prompt with the word; checkpoint 2 on colour renders of every look on the eight profiles, the census's Glowseed cell (the object against the page's own AudioContext) and tokens test 13

rulings.order: D - the placeholder now, the pixel seed at step 6 to the locked camera
rulings.scaffold: a - the object stays idle through Build-it's scaffold; the slot's cue ring is the one event there; the scaffold's timing untouched
rulings.fallback: a - idle on every system-speech path (recorded audio only); the Grown-ups corner's note says the listening light stays dark
rulings.soundOff: "Parent: sound is off" on the strip's reserved marker line, the replay controls disabled, the object muted

glowseed.silhouette: an ovoid with one asymmetric tip at the top right (the tightest corner radius, 34% against the top left's 70%) and the core offset 1.5 CSS px right and 2.5 px down from the box's centre - NOT a circle with a centred core. The first draft was four concentric ovals, the core exactly centred in x and 2 px low in y, both caps 6 px at 1x: the art director failed checkpoint 1 on it as the eye / LED / bullseye form bible 17.1 forbids, and both verifiers measured the same thing. Order D says the step-6 pixel seed keeps this shape, so the radius and the offset are in the lock and read from the stylesheet by glowseedLockFromSources; a core back on either axis is refused by name.
